n: Stanford CRAFT Can AI help with storytelling
t: A 45 minute Stanford CRAFT language arts lesson on AI and storytelling.
steps: Find the lesson on the Stanford CRAFT site.
Open the teacher guide, which is a Google Doc.
Read the Conversation article and the New York Times opinion piece.
Preview the YouTube tutorial on AI animated story videos.
Check that your school allows Google Docs and YouTube.
Teach the lesson in one 45 minute period.
